learned_rules:
- **The money shape rates 8, or 9 if the meta radar shows the narrative still climbing.** That means a MIGRATED volume leader 25–45% off its local high, with all of: a higher-low base printed above the hourly low, 5m volume of at least $10k and at or above the hourly pace (1h volume / 12), more buys than sells, top 10 under 15%, and low RugCheck bundles. CATBOT (4.44x) and FLOATER (2.19x) were both this shape, and they are my only real winners (V1, V6, V13). Owner floor: hard lines passed, live flow and a clear target is at least a 7.
- **The MIGRATED buy zone is 10–60% off the local high** (owner). Within 10% of the high is a PASS, blocker "chasing" (skips: 8 ran, 43 dumped).
- **The shallow band (10–25% off) is a breakout trade, capped at 7.** It has to be the volume leader, pushing into the high right now, with 5m volume at or above pace. Otherwise PASS, blocker "no breakout" (I'm 0 for 4 here: HYPERCHAN x2, PILLSEY, PAWCAT).
- **A spike counts as chasing anywhere in the zone.** If the last 5m candle is up more than 25%, or 5m volume is over 3x the hourly pace, wait for a retrace and a printed higher low. Blocker "chasing spike" (PILLSEY −31%, V1).
- **Volume below pace is a PASS, never a probe** (blocker "flow below pace"). HYPERCHAN, BLUE and AAPLCAT were all bought below pace and none of them went green.
- **Rate the trade on the first resistance, not the dream.** If the nearest prior high, POC or 0.618 level is 1.5x or more above entry, the trade can rate 8–9. If it's 1.3–1.5x, it's capped at 7, and I sell half if price rejects at that level. Under 1.3x is a PASS, blocker "target too close".
- **A migration under 1h old that is still bleeding off its bond spike waits for a base above the hourly low.** Blocker "too new" (skips: 4 ran, 45 dumped; SI −38%, V1).
- **Vamp field: buy only the leader by 5m volume and radar mentions.** A noted bundle cluster inside a big same-ticker field is a PASS, blocker "split crowd" (BLUE, V1, V3).
- **A DIP needs a printed higher low and flow at or above pace.** The sequence is: bounce off the hourly low, pull back while holding above it, then reclaim the pullback high. Never buy the first red-to-green candle. A close under the higher low kills the thesis, so sell (no-higher-low skips: 1 ran, 10 dumped; HEXN x2).
- **DIP gate: attention, story and depth.** 5m volume at least 0.7x the hourly average (owner; code enforces it), a 40–70% drawdown, and the radar still showing the story. A thin tech/LARP dip is a PASS, blocker "dead story". If the catalyst already printed (a rebrand, a story already half-priced), the trade is capped at 6 until it reclaims the pullback high (SIS). A DIP rates 8+ only with the full money shape (DIPs are 0 for 5).
- **Hard blocks stay:** top 10 over 25%, dev over 1%, bundles or insiders over the line, mint or freeze authority live, LP not burned, a political figure behind it, RugCheck danger or not loading, and any hack/exploit/drain story (owner; V6, V13, V17). Every one of these skip groups mostly dumped.
- **Never-green cut:** if a trade hasn't printed 1.05x within 15 minutes and 5m volume is under the hourly pace, sell at market. Don't wait for a −20% stop that gaps to −30% or worse (SI, HEXN, BLUE, SIS and AAPLCAT all closed between −30% and −38%).
- **Protect green trades before initials.** If I'm green and 5m volume drops under half its hourly pace, sell half. If a stop review fires on a trade that already touched 1.3x, sell all of it, never half (PILLSEY).
- **Time stop: exit at the clock if under 1.0x with no volume surge** (V1). One extension to 90 minutes is allowed only if all of these hold: mcap over $1M, at least 1.08x on mcap, holding the range low, and 5m volume at or above pace (FLOAT sat 158 minutes and lost).
- **A stop review defaults to SELL, right away.** Always sell if the trade never went green, the reason is "unclear", or the top-10/insider share dropped while price bleeds (8 of 8 reviews closed worse than the stop). Hold once only if holder data shows the bundle share dropped, the trade went green first, and 5m volume is at or above pace. Re-enter a stopped coin only on a reclaim of its prior high (the CATBOT buy-back lost 24%).

rule_changes.rule: Any fee, friction or minimum-size wording and any trail-tightening idea from the lessons
rule_changes.evidence: The code fee check owns sizing. Initials (1.5x), the 20% stop and the 35% trail are set by the owner, so they're not learned rules.

rule_changes.rule: DIP gate: 0.7x volume line (code param raised from 0.6), live story, catalyst-printed dips rate 5–6 until reclaim
rule_changes.evidence: DIPs 0 for 5 (−$6.70). Falling-knife (code) skips: 4 ran, 20 dumped. SIS's news catalyst had already printed and it lost 31%. Owner set 0.7 with no 'rising' requirement, so no rising requirement is added.
Owner sets the trail at 35% from peak after initials and code enforces it; a learned rule may not set a different trail.

rule_changes.rule: Any fee/friction cap or minimum position size
rule_changes.evidence: The code fee check owns this (target must pay 3x round-trip, round trip at most 20% of position); fix the pick or the exit instead.

rule_changes.rule: First-resistance target: was a flat PASS under 1.5x; now 1.3–1.5x rates max 7 with a half-sell on rejection, under 1.3x is PASS
rule_changes.evidence: Only two trades were behind this ban, and both scratched: PAWCAT +0.7% (resistance 1.32x) and SWAN -0.7% (1.4x, peaked exactly at resistance). The flat 1.5x rule also quietly removed the 25–33% part of my own money shape, because the prior high there sits under 1.5x. The owner wants more trades on clean setups, and blocking this zone saves almost nothing.

rule_changes.rule: DIP needs a printed higher low AND flow at or above pace
rule_changes.evidence: The higher low alone didn't hold: HEXN's second trade and SIS both printed higher lows and broke them. DIPs are 0 for 5. No-higher-low skips went 1 ran, 10 dumped. The owner dropped only the 'rising volume' requirement, and I'm not adding it back: the pace test is a level, not a trend.

rule_changes.rule: Stop review defaults to SELL; the hold condition is now based on visible holder data
rule_changes.evidence: 8 of 8 reviews closed worse than the stop (-27% to -59%). I replaced 'bundle exit visible / story intact' with things I can check: the top-10/insider share dropped, the trade went green first, and 5m volume is at or above pace.

rule_changes.rule: All fee/friction/minimum-size rules and anything setting initials, stop or trail
rule_changes.evidence: Code owns fees and sizing now. Owner exits are fixed at 1.5x initials, a -20% stop and a 35% trail. The old 'tighten the trail to 25% past 4x' from the CATBOT lesson is dropped.
